x_failures: Cites Zhuangzi Vol. 2 p.57 for following the 'Human Dao' by 'non-action', but the page says 'Once there is action, it becomes the Human Dao'. It also adds that the soul is 'made of the same essence as the world-soul', which Propaedeutik p.102 does not say.
y_failures: Cites Deliverance from Error p.52 for the Ikhwan's microcosm teaching and Al-Ghazali's 'critiques', but that page covers only Sufi contemplation and never mentions the Ikhwan. It also attributes 'disorder the world' and 'exchange one's nature' to Vol. 2 p.6, but those phrases are on p.9.
reason: X backs its Ikhwan parallel with real Ikhwan pages (Dieterici's 'man in the large' passage and the music and spheres passage), and its one misreading of the Human Dao is minor. Y's whole Ikhwan section rests on an unrelated Al-Ghazali page about Sufism, a more serious grounding failure.
